summary: Examples: 8 | pow(5) is 32768, 2 | pow(2) is 4, and me | pow(3).
questions: What's an example of the pow filter?

answer_card.title: pow examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
eight_power_five: "{{ 8 | pow(5) }}"   # 32768
square_of_2: "{{ 2 | pow(2) }}"        # 4
cube_me: "{{ me | pow(3) }}"
```
